visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black lace crop top and a long black skirt with a high slit, stands in a brightly lit indoor doorway. She is holding a white makeup compact and applying powder to her face while looking towards the camera as if it were a mirror. In the background, visible through an open door, is a walk-in closet filled with hanging clothes. A shirtless man wrapped in a grey towel emerges from the closet, leans against the door frame, and watches the woman. A small grey and brown cat walks across the floor in the background closet area. (2) The scene continues with the woman still touching up her makeup. The man disappears briefly and then reappears fully dressed in a beige short-sleeved button-down shirt over a black t-shirt and dark shorts. He walks forward into the same room as the woman. (3) The man stands beside the woman and strikes a pose. She finishes her makeup, looks at him, and they both smile. He then hooks his arm into hers, and they both walk forward together, exiting the frame towards the camera's position.
